what_this_file_fixes: Two defects in the 2026-08-14 B08 leg-1 prereg, both measured 0-GPU on wzc1 this session.

defect_1_closure_premise_measured_at_wro.problem: evidence/b08_lme_bm25_recall_topk{5,10,20,50}.json all carry evidence_token_budget=0, but the gate FREEZES --evidence_token_budget 4000. longmemeval/run_baseline.py:142 applies _apply_token_budget BEFORE recall_at_k at line 144, so truncation can DROP gold sessions. The retrieval-closure premise was therefore never verified at the gate's own config.
defect_1_closure_premise_measured_at_wro.resolution: RE-MEASURED at budget=4000. Closure SURVIVES on the chosen stratum; it does NOT survive elsewhere. Stratum choice is now validated at the gate's actual config.
defect_1_closure_premise_measured_at_wro.stratum_verdict: knowledge-update any_hit 1.000 -> 1.000 (cov 0.99359 -> 0.99359); single-session-assistant 1.000 -> 1.000 (cov 1.00000 -> 1.00000). mean evidence blocks drops 10.0 -> 7.923 / 8.964, i.e. truncation IS active on the stratum yet removes no gold session.
defect_1_closure_premise_measured_at_wro.off_stratum_degradation: overall any_hit 0.9680 -> 0.9600; single-session-preference 0.7667 -> 0.7000; multi-session 0.98496 -> 0.96992 (cov 0.85288 -> 0.80138); temporal-reasoning any_hit unchanged 0.95489 but cov 0.88897 -> 0.87206. Confirms closure must be measured per cell at the deployed budget, never assumed.

defect_2_cost_anchor_used_the_wrong_A02_.problem: prereg cited latency_decomposition/comem = 0.1097 ms/prefill-token. `comem` is the COMPRESSED depth-j read path. longmemeval/reader.py LocalHFReader._build_prompt does a PLAIN full raw-text prefill, which is A02's j0_top12 arm (matched-pack raw-text RAG, per code/bench_a02_storage_readcompute.py:56).
defect_2_cost_anchor_used_the_wrong_A02_.impact: prefill understated by 38.4%. Total barely moves because decode dominates (334 s decode vs 80 s prefill at n=134), so the ~1.1 GPU-h headline SURVIVES -- but the basis must cite j0_top12, not comem.

corrected_cost_arithmetic.formula: 3 answer arms x (sum_prefill*0.15180ms + n*64*39.00ms) + 1 notes pass (sum_prefill*0.15180ms + n*128*39.00ms)

defect_3_K2_is_not_evaluable_at_n134_KIL.problem: K2 as written fires iff the Delta_U 95% CI UPPER BOUND < +5.0 pp. At n=134 the paired half-width is 1.96*sqrt(disc_U/134). Even with a TRUE Delta_U of exactly 0, the UB lands below +5.0 pp only if disc_U <= 0.0872. For any unsupported-claim discordance above 8.72% -- entirely plausible for a hallucination metric on a base model -- K2 can NEVER fire, so the ALL-THREE KILL branch becomes UNREACHABLE. The gate would then be one that can only pass or abstain: not a gate.
defect_3_K2_is_not_evaluable_at_n134_KIL.required_fix: An EVALUABILITY PRECONDITION pre-committed before scoring: compute disc_U (the observed unsupported-claim discordance between A-notes-only and A-raw) FIRST. If disc_U > 0.0872, n=134 cannot resolve K2 and the stratum is extended to the full n=500 (measured 4.31 GPU-h, same three arms, same frozen retrieval), which holds the half-width at 3.92 pp even at disc_U=0.20. The escalation must be decided from disc_U ALONE and BEFORE Delta_aug's sign is inspected, so it is a pre-registered precondition and not an n-hack.
